PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (18.0, 12.0, 22.0),     # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),        # input pair L
    "Itail": (170e-6, 120e-6, 190e-6),
    "Ic":    (15e-6, 8e-6, 30e-6),   # cascode branch current
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # PMOS source / cascode L
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # NMOS mirror / cascode L
    "gmidp": (10.0, 7.0, 13.0),      # PMOS current sources
    "gmidn": (8.0, 6.0, 12.0),       # NMOS bottom mirror
    "vmarg": (0.28, 0.2, 0.4),       # Vds target on cascoded current sources
}

def _match_vgs(lut, dev, L, Id, vgs_t, vds=None, vsb=0.0):
    best = None
    for g in np.linspace(3.0, 20.0, 69):
        op = lut.size(dev, float(g), L, Id, vds=(vds if vds else vgs_t), vsb=vsb)
        e = abs(op.vgs - vgs_t)
        if best is None or e < best[0]:
            best = (e, op)
    return best[1]

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 1e-10)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    I1 = p["Itail"] / 2.0
    Ic = p["Ic"]
    Itop = I1 + Ic
    Ib = 5e-6
    vm = p["vmarg"]

    # input pair (source ~0.3 V -> body effect)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=vdd - vm - 0.3, vsb=0.3)
    vtail = max(vcm - m1.vgs, 0.15)
    # tail + reference mirror
    mref = lut.size("n", 10.0, 1.0, iref, vds=0.7)
    mt = lut.size("n", 10.0, 1.0, p["Itail"], vds=vtail)
    mbs = lut.size("n", 10.0, 1.0, Ib, vds=0.9)           # bias sinks (5 uA)
    mbs2 = lut.size("n", 10.0, 1.0, 2 * Ib, vds=0.9)      # sink for vbp diode (10 uA)
    # PMOS top sources and their diode reference
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Itop, vds=vm)
    mpd = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], 2 * Ib, vds=0.8)
    mpb = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Ib, vds=0.8)  # 5 uA source feeding vbnc diode
    # PMOS cascodes
    mpc = lut.size("p", 12.0, p["Lp"], Ic, vds=0.5, vsb=vm)
    vbpc = vdd - vm - mpc.vgs
    mpcd = _match_vgs(lut, "p", 2.0, Ib, vdd - vbpc)          # diode generating vbpc
    # NMOS bottom mirror (wide swing) + cascodes
    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], Ic, vds=vm)
    mnc = lut.size("n", 12.0, p["Ln"], Ic, vds=0.5, vsb=vm)
    vbnc = vm + mnc.vgs
    mncd = _match_vgs(lut, "n", 2.0, Ib, vbnc)               # diode generating vbnc

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # reference
    n.dev("MR", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mref)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # vbp generation
    n.dev("MS1", "vbp", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mbs2)
    n.dev("MPD", "vbp", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mpd)
    # vbpc generation
    n.dev("MS2", "vbpc", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mbs)
    n.dev("MPCD", "vbpc", "vbpc", "vdd", "vdd", mpcd)
    # vbnc generation
    n.dev("MPB", "vbnc", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mpb)
    n.dev("MNCD", "vbnc", "vbnc", "vss", "vss", mncd)
    # input pair
    n.dev("M1", "fa", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "fb", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    # top PMOS sources
    n.dev("M3", "fa", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M4", "fb", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    # PMOS cascodes
    n.dev("M5", "nl", "vbpc", "fa", "vdd", mpc)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "vbpc", "fb", "vdd", mpc)
    # NMOS cascodes + wide-swing mirror
    n.dev("M7", "nl", "vbnc", "sl", "vss", mnc)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "vbnc", "sr", "vss", mnc)
    n.dev("M9", "sl", "nl", "vss", "vss", mn)
    n.dev("M10", "sr", "nl", "vss", "vss", mn)

    # predictions
    gm1 = m1.gm
    rup = (mpc.gm + mpc.gmbs) / mpc.gds / (mp.gds + m1.gds)
    rdn = (mnc.gm + mnc.gmbs) / mnc.gds / mn.gds
    rout = rup * rdn / (rup + rdn)
    a0 = gm1 * rout
    cout = cl + mpc.cdd + mnc.cdd
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cout)
    cfold = m1.cdd + mp.cdd + mpc.cgg
    p2 = mpc.gm / (2 * PI * cfold)
    cmir = 2 * mn.cgg + mnc.cdd
    p3 = mn.gm / (2 * PI * cmir)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - 0.5 * math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3))
    itot = iref + 2 * Itop + 2 * Ib + Ib + Ib
    power = vdd * itot
    slew = min(p["Itail"], 2 * Ic + 0.0) / cl if Ic < I1 else p["Itail"] / cl
    return n, {"gain_db": db(a0), "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "slew": p["Itail"] / cl}
